test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube, which of the following figures is possible ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/386224253ecffaabbf971b59de2f5f36fc7662e03b93ba6793f47aa2dae07b1d.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe174c78cb0e8e755febcdc4d1bae1af293a3742b738c2d0c4a3d903aa51afb.png] 

7 and 9 is the opposite sides.

X and Z is the opposite sides.

8 and Y is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334ffa45be777e03e89086181b0cfd74a237fba86814ed7338d2952dfc14f347.png] → Can not be made, because 7 and 9 is the opposite sides.

**Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df29bd9c05eb09c2fb60495c8aef63451c6581fe17882d389ab9613f1f64ac99.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3938635ce6ba90cafa1a2d12ad74fdf23454e5b3e2cb922aa21bdc273a93aa9b.png] → Can not be made, because 7 and 9 is the opposite sides.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45cb3a768aa65548b6e75a0c3bf1ddf024832095924f67d72a43461541d55c26.png] → Can not be made, because X and Z is the opposite sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
